title: A width the layers refused stops claiming the number you typed
goal: Pick two labels and type 200 into W. Both boxes go to 204, because a text box will not go narrower than its own words, but the W field goes on showing 200. The number in the box has to be the number the layers actually took, or the next arrow key steps from a width nothing has.
notes: Sources/Photonz/GeometryInspector.swift, GeometryField.land(): it already calls landing(parsed) and shows display(landed), so the miss is that landing() is computed before commit and does not see the per-layer clamp for a multi-layer selection. Reproduced in Scripts/playtest/mixed-one-look-walk.json (step focus W, type 200): the tree reports both text layers at 204 while the field reads 200. Found while doing mixed-reads-the-same-way-in-every-control.
acceptance: Typing a width the layers refuse leaves the field showing what they took, not what was asked for
An arrow key pressed straight after steps from that same number
Nothing changes when the layers accept the number as typed
Verified in the probe with a real screen capture
